planner: US (JCS contingency planning, as understood by State Policy Planning: Smith)
source_doc: FRUS 1958-60 vol. XIX China, doc. 63: Memorandum from the Assistant Secretary of State for Policy Planning (Gerard Smith) to Dulles, "Comments on Summary No. 2 re Quemoy and Matsu", 3 Sep 1958; https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/frus1958-60v19/d63
quote: the striking of military targets within a 500-mile radius from the islands, including targets in the Shanghai, Nanking, and Canton areas, and on enemy strike bases wherever located in China.
notes: Second-hand account of JCS contingency planning for the defence of Quemoy and Matsu (nuclear: same paragraph says the JCS "spoke yesterday only of nuclear strikes against airfields along the coast opposite the Offshore Islands"). Shanghai also appears in us_1958_taiwan_strait (Twining). Areas, not aim points.
